This [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] '''individual''' served as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Sky Battle of Quell]] and operated a [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]].<ref name="Jedi Crash" />

==Biography==
This [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was part of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] rescue team to save Master [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and the remaining [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] inside her flagship the [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']]. The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] pilot died when multiple [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] fired at the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and had shot the clone, causing him to hit the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] button, which resulted in the ship going to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Jedi Crash" />
